hard_gates.name: current-policy-before-preview-contract
hard_gates.evidence: The historical verifier resolved policy and previews in an order that no longer matched fail-closed invalidation.

hard_gates.name: course-bound-final-approval-contract
hard_gates.evidence: The historical verifier approved setup before course binding, which the current product correctly revokes.

hard_gates.name: server-owned-ingestion-lineage-contract
hard_gates.evidence: The historical verifier submitted browser-returned chunks rather than current server-owned ingestion job IDs.

hard_gates.name: complete-failure-diagnostics
hard_gates.evidence: The historical result recorded only the exception type and could show all recorded checks passed despite an unrecorded failure.

hard_gates.name: zero-model-and-private-data-boundary
hard_gates.evidence: The historical local/container package used synthetic data and zero model calls.

hard_gates.name: current-policy-before-preview-contract
hard_gates.evidence: Policy and non-preview checklist fields are finalized before preview acceptance, with final professor approval last.

hard_gates.name: course-bound-final-approval-contract
hard_gates.evidence: Setup is bound to the professor-owned course before policy/preview review and final approval.

hard_gates.name: server-owned-ingestion-lineage-contract
hard_gates.evidence: Staging release creation uses the completed professor/course-owned ingestion job ID and never trusts browser chunks.

hard_gates.name: complete-failure-diagnostics
hard_gates.evidence: Every caught failure records class, stage, exception type, and a bounded safe message; the complete 42-gate path is now a regression test.

hard_gates.name: zero-model-and-private-data-boundary
hard_gates.evidence: The clean run read only generated synthetic data, made zero model/provider calls, and cost USD 0.

decision.rationale: The current implementation and verifier agree on fail-closed professor review and server-owned source lineage, and all 42 in-process deployment, recovery, capacity, and rollback gates pass on a clean revision.
limitations: The current V7 container image was not built because the local Docker engine stalled on pinned registry metadata and did not recover within the bounded retry.
Historical V5 container and HTTPS evidence does not establish compatibility for the current code revision.
Public DNS, trusted TLS, target-host restore, target-host operations, realistic source quality, professor fidelity, and human usability remain pending.
The run used synthetic data, deterministic generation, one development machine, and a 100-request local capacity probe; it does not establish an SLA.
